summary.text: Pat Dixon is an engineer, a former Lago Vista city council member and former chair of the Libertarian Party of Texas. He ran for the Texas Senate in 2022 (District 14) and 2024 (District 20).

paragraphs.text: Moved to Texas in 1997 and served on the Lago Vista City Council; described as a former chair of the Libertarian Party of Texas.
